verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill: a folder with a SKILL.md and dependency-free local Python tools that runs inside a host agent. It operates no hosted storage service of its own, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Any residency controls would belong to the host agent platform, not to the skill.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
